name: Meatloaf
author: Rita Koeppel
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Place in round or rectangle pan and shape as a loaf. Poke holes about 3/4 to 1 inch deep with finger in several spots on top of loaf. Cut green pepper in 4 to 6 pieces and lay them around edge of loaf. Pour topping over meat loaf, filling the holes. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 300°.
